title: Concept: Payment card number served in a response
description: A PAN in a response links a cardholder to the site and survives in browser caches, proxies and logs. Even a test card in production markup tells an attacker which processor and format the site accepts.
applicability: Checkout receipts, order-history pages and payment API responses.
risk: The caller obtains a usable card number for the account holder, and any proxy or cache between the server and the browser keeps a second copy.
